value.summary: Inspected lib/logger.mjs. It is 3 lines: a single named export log(message) that writes the message to console.error. No level constants, no formatting, no other exports. The repository context lists only the lib and specs directories with no other source files, and no imports of lib/logger.mjs appear anywhere in the provided repository material, so there are no in-repo callers whose call sites would need updating; the only compatibility constraint is keeping the log(message) export behaving as it does today.

observations.statement: lib/logger.mjs exports exactly one function, log(message), which calls console.error(message); there is no existing level machinery.
No other modules in the repository import lib/logger.mjs, so adding new exports alongside log() cannot break existing callers; preserving log() itself is sufficient for backward compatibility.
